pcf_sel_orden_prod: Select an order to see the details.
pcf_hint_op_planificar: Next step: schedule it (assign line, date and technician).
pcf_hint_op_finalizar: Next step: mark the order as finished.
pcf_hint_op_entregar: Unit finished. Pickup and balance collection are handled from Sales.
pcf_compras_faltantes: Missing (low stock) — enter the quantity to order:
pcf_sel_orden: Select a purchase order to see the details.
pcf_sin_faltantes: There are no supplies below stock.
pcf_hint_cotizar: Next step: request a quote from a supplier.
pcf_hint_aprobar: Next step: the manager approves or rejects the quote.
pcf_hint_recibir: Next step: receive the supplies (adds stock).
pcf_hint_finalizada: Order finished. The supplies were received.
pcf_seleccione_registro: Select a record from the list.
pcf_sel_venta: Pick a sale from the list to see its details.
pcf_hint_vta_senar: Collect the 50% deposit and issue the receipt.
pcf_hint_vta_esperando_orden: Deposit collected. The manager can now create the production order.
pcf_hint_vta_en_fabrica: The computer is in production. Pickup is handled in "Computer delivery".
pcf_hint_vta_retiro: The unit is ready: register the pickup in "Computer delivery".
pcf_hint_vta_entregada: Sale closed: balance paid and computer delivered.
pcf_hint_vta_anulada: Sale cancelled. Reserved components were released.
pcf_cc_obs_requerida: If the unit fails the check, please write down the fault notes.
pcf_sin_ventas_pendientes: There are no deposited sales without a production order.
pcf_sin_lineas: No assembly lines available. The order stays on hold.
pcf_hint_op_cerrar: Complete the quality check to close the order and assign the serial number.
pcf_hint_op_revision: The unit failed the quality check. Fix the fault and check it again.
pcf_buscar_orden_dni: Search by order no. or ID
pcf_sel_entrega: Pick a computer from the list to see its details.
pcf_hint_ent_cobrar: Collect the outstanding balance, hand over the unit and issue the invoice.
pcf_recibo_generado: The deposit receipt was saved to:
pcf_desea_imprimir_recibo: Do you want to print the receipt?
pcf_desea_imprimir_factura: Do you want to print the invoice?
error_permisos_inconsistentes: The role's permissions are inconsistent: a patent is duplicated (assigned directly and inherited from a family). Fix it from Roles.
pcf_bitacora_ya_vigente: That version is already the current one.
pcf_bitacora_confirmar_activar: Restore the version of component {0} from {1} as the current one?
pcf_bitacora_activada: The historical version was restored as the current one.
pcf_confirmar_baja_componente: Delete component {0}? Nothing is erased: the change log keeps it and it can be restored.
pcf_asis_sin_faltantes: No components are below the reorder point.
pcf_asis_elegir_uno: Pick at least one component to continue.
pcf_asis_hint1: Tap the components you want to restock. The bar shows stock against the reorder point.
pcf_asis_hint2: Set the date you need the parts by.
pcf_asis_hint3: Review the order and register it. It stays Pending until it is quoted.
pcf_cot_sin_ofertas: No quotes for this order yet. Add the first one below.
pcf_cot_elegi_orden: Pick an order on the left to compare its quotes.
pcf_cot_falta_proveedor: Pick a supplier to add the quote.
pcf_cot_costo_invalido: Cost must be a valid, non-negative number.
pcf_cot_repetido: {0} already has an open quote on this order. Discard it before adding another.
pcf_cot_confirmar_adj: Award this purchase to {0} for {1}? All other quotes are discarded and the order moves to Sent.
pcf_armar_opcional: This part is optional: you can skip it.
pcf_armar_obligatorio: This part is required for the PC to work.
pcf_armar_sin_opciones: No components of this type are loaded.
pcf_armar_sin_catalogo: No components loaded. Add components first.
pcf_elegi_linea: Pick an assembly line to continue.
pcf_plan_ayuda: Choose the line that will assemble the unit and when it starts.
pcf_cc_ayuda: Check the finished unit. If it passes all four tests the order is closed and gets a serial number.
pcf_cc_encendido_det: Boots, reaches BIOS and shows no fault signs.
pcf_cc_conexiones_det: Cables, screws and connectors tight; nothing loose inside.
pcf_cc_so_det: Operating system installed and booting without errors.
pcf_cc_drivers_det: Chipset, video, audio and network drivers working.
pcf_cc_veredicto_ok: Passes: confirming deducts stock, assigns the serial number and closes the order.
pcf_cc_veredicto_falla: {0} check(s) missing: the order goes back to review and you must explain why in the notes.
pcf_venta_ayuda: Pick the customer, build the machine and set the delivery date. The ticket on the right updates itself.
pcf_venta_tipo_estandar_det: A predefined machine, ready to sell
pcf_venta_tipo_config_det: Built part by part with the customer
pcf_venta_ticket_vacio: No machine yet. Pick a standard model or build a custom one.
pcf_sena_ayuda: The deposit is 50% of the total and cannot be changed. Choose how it is collected.
pcf_entrega_ayuda: Collect the balance and hand the machine to the customer.
pcf_orden_ayuda: Pick the deposited sale that goes into production and confirm the delivery date.
pcf_rec_ayuda: Tick what actually arrived. Only what you declare here is added to stock.
pcf_rec_nada: Tick at least one received component.
pcf_rec_ver_completa: Everything arrived ({0} u.): confirming adds the stock and closes the order.
pcf_rec_ver_parcial: {0} u. arriving, {1} u. still pending: the order stays Partially received and you can take the rest later.
pcf_rec_ok_completa: Order #{0} fully received: stock added and order closed.
pcf_rec_ok_parcial: Order #{0} partially received: what arrived was added. The shortfall is recorded and can be received later.
pcf_cotp_ayuda: Pick the supplier you are asking and enter the price they offered for this order.
pcf_cotp_sin_proveedores: No suppliers yet. Create the first one with “＋ New supplier”.
pcf_cotp_falta_proveedor: Pick a supplier to request the quote.
pcf_cotp_costo_invalido: The offered cost must be a valid number greater than zero.
